effects.description: (5 items) When you cast a damage shield, you call down a fragment of Trinimac that heals you and group members for 1396 Health and damages enemies for 1396 Magic damage in a |cffffff5|r meter radius after a |cffffff2|r second delay. This effect can occur once every |cffffff5|r seconds and scales with the higher of your Max Magicka or Stamina.
